nodes.title: Positive Prompt (3-paragraph prose)
widgets_values:
An adult woman dancer in her late twenties wearing an ink-black modern kimono wrap with wide flowing indigo-and-ivory silk sleeves and a woven obi sash spins dynamically across a rain-dampened stone temple courtyard beneath crisscrossing rows of paper festival lanterns. Arched in a sweeping diagonal mid-spin twist, her right hand holds the wooden wand of a long billowing crimson silk dance ribbon trailing in a bright spiral arc through the night air while her left palm rests lightly against her waist sash, her dark hair fanning outward amid swirling scarlet autumn maple leaves.

Steep high-angle three-quarter action shot looking down from an upper wooden temple balcony, shadowed maple boughs framing the upper-left corner for depth; warm amber-orange light from dozens of suspended paper lanterns pools across the wet stone flagstones and illuminates her upturned face and spinning sleeves against deep midnight-indigo roof eaves.

Modern theatrical anime illustration with expressive kinetic ink linework, a modern anime face with an adult's proportions, large vivid eyes with gradient irises and layered highlights, a small nose and a narrow chin; glossy dark hair fanning in fine strand lines, muted wet charcoal stone and deep indigo base with warm lantern amber and a single sweeping scarlet silk-and-maple accent.
